history.title: Our History
history.subtitle: The essence of the Argentine Sea
history.p1: At From Patagonia, our essence is the Argentine Sea. We are a family-owned, historic company dedicated to the extraction, processing and export of fish and seafood with decades of experience, integrating the entire value chain: from capture in our cold, crystalline waters to global logistics ensuring the product reaches international markets in absolute freshness conditions.
history.p2: We operate with our own fleet, process in our Mar del Plata and Trelew plants with the highest sanitary standards, and our brand and industry are synonymous with total traceability throughout the entire production circuit. We export the richness of our coasts to the world, with the seriousness and commitment that the most demanding markets require.
history.p3: Well-known Argentine companies in the global market entrust their productions to us because we have extensive experience in this!

vision.title: Our Vision
vision.quote: To consolidate ourselves as the undisputed benchmark in the export of Argentine Sea products globally, maintaining the excellence in quality, traceability and sustainability that characterizes us.
